opportunities.name: Case file review assistance
opportunities.why_now: Production classification and pilot drafting signals align with the county priority for complete records and reviewable decisions.
opportunities.decision_ask: Authorize an on-prem architecture validation and a human-reviewed historical-case pilot.
opportunities.business_problem: Records and Program Integrity staff assemble file context across a file share and mainframe before drafting the next action.
opportunities.agentic_enhancement: Classify file contents, summarize missing evidence, and draft a next-action recommendation without autonomous system writes.

controls: Require human approval before every mainframe write
deployment.notes: Capability availability and model hosting must be proven in the on-premises environment before design approval.

value_case.label: high
value_case.basis: Documented volume and repeated review work indicate material capacity and quality potential; handling time is not available.

opportunities.feasibility: Begin with offline historical files and read-only mainframe context after architecture validation.
opportunities.governance: Keep restricted records on-premises, log source citations, and require reviewer approval before any system write.
validation_questions: Which customer-managed model endpoint is approved for restricted case data?
Can the pilot run without public internet egress and without autonomous writes?

pilot.objective: Measure summary completeness and reviewer acceptance on closed historical cases.
pilot.narrow_scope: One records category, historical files only, and no mainframe write-back.
pilot.agent_role: Classify documents, identify missing evidence, and draft a cited case summary.
pilot.human_role: Review every summary and make all case decisions and system updates.
exit_criteria: At least 90 percent reviewer acceptance with zero public egress or autonomous writes
pilot.first_step: Complete an architecture review for model hosting, logs, and data movement.
